tools.name: github_disconnect
tools.title: Disconnect the project from its GitHub repository
tools.description: Disconnect the project from its GitHub repository.

format.description: Read-only choice of the answer: "text" (default) is the view; "data" is the same facts as one JSON block, for a client that parses them.

tools.name: github_get_changes
tools.title: Get repository changes since the last sync
tools.description: Get repository changes since the last sync: the file list only. Moves the sync marker: a second call returns nothing.

limit.description: How many changed files to list (1-200); the count is always the whole number.

format.description: Read-only choice of the answer: "text" (default) is the view; "data" is the same facts as one JSON block, for a client that parses them.

tools.name: github_get_status
tools.title: Get the project's GitHub link status
tools.description: Get the project's GitHub link status; include=history adds recent pushes and pulls.

history_limit.description: With include history: how many syncs (1-50).

format.description: Read-only choice of the answer: "text" (default) is the view; "data" is the same facts as one JSON block, for a client that parses them.

tools.name: github_plan_push
tools.title: Plan a push
tools.description: Plan a push: the diff a composition's push would produce; writes nothing.

composition_id.description: The composition: its id or name; default: the one of this workspace.

diffs.description: true: a short diff per file (up to 10 files, 40 lines each); without it, the file list.

format.description: Read-only choice of the answer: "text" (default) is the view; "data" is the same facts as one JSON block, for a client that parses them.

tools.name: github_push
tools.title: Push a composition's generated Gatling project to the repository
tools.description: Push a composition's generated Gatling project to the linked repository.

composition_id.description: The composition: its id or name; default: the one of this workspace.

create_pr.description: true: open a pull request instead of committing to the branch.

format.description: Read-only choice of the answer: "text" (default) is the view; "data" is the same facts as one JSON block, for a client that parses them.
